breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Dirichlet and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification correctly omitted the contradictory periodic condition and only stated the Dirichlet condition, 'u=0 on all four edges', thus resolving the inconsistency.
